title: Preserve native direct-update response shape
invariant: A native direct-update response preserves the earlier public response shape and does not add the backend artifact field.
scope: NativeLifecycleProvider.call for atom_lifecycle_direct_update with an ordinary non-workflow backend result. The modeled inputs are completed status and backend artifact presence. Compatibility is measured against the pre-regression response shape, not a general rule for other lifecycle operations.
